picture.opening: Scene 1 shows the subject of the first sentence from frame 0, already moving: a diagram already building or a photograph already pushing in. Never a title card, a blank or black frame, or an abstract gradient.
picture.turn: A new scene starts on the first word of a turn or a re-opening, and its picture is visibly different from the scene before (a new image, the diagram's next state, a new place). Never merge that segment into the scene before it.
picture.payoff: The payoff scene gets the video's strongest picture: the hero image, the largest element, the diagram fully built.
picture.ending: Hold on the payoff picture to the last frame. No closing card, logo, recap or sign-off after it.

best_for: real, specific subjects the viewer came to see: products, screenshots, named people and places as images
image-led topics where full-bleed imagery carries the beats
avoid_for: topics whose beats are generic roles acted out by people
signals: the script names specific real things that are best shown as pictures
most beats want a full-frame image or a vector diagram, none wants a character
